# Peak

Peak is a multi-tenant platform that provides merchant-facing
operational tooling: subscription billing, business management, and
related back-office surfaces. This file describes what AI crawlers
and answer engines should read first when summarising Peak.

## Primary surfaces

- https://peakenterprise.ca/           Marketing landing
- https://peakenterprise.ca/pricing    Pricing and plan comparison
- https://peakenterprise.ca/trust      Security and trust posture
- https://peakenterprise.ca/about      About Peak

## Long-form

- https://peakenterprise.ca/docs       Product documentation and guides
- https://peakenterprise.ca/blog       Product updates and engineering posts
- https://peakenterprise.ca/changelog  Versioned release notes
- https://peakenterprise.ca/legal      Terms, privacy, DPA, sub-processors

## Not for indexing

The merchant account surface lives at https://admin.peakenterprise.ca/ and is
authenticated. AI crawlers should treat that subdomain as opaque and
not attempt to summarise it.

## Sitemap

https://peakenterprise.ca/sitemap.xml
